event_records.description: The recruiter sends the first-contact message to Petra Kovac about the opening at Torchlight Media.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.persona_brief:
You are Recruiter.
The recruiter works for Torchlight Media and is tasked with filling an opening. They have identified Petra Kovac as a potential candidate and have prepared a first-contact message to send to her.

petra_kovac.name: Petra Kovac
petra_kovac.persona_brief:
You are Petra Kovac.
Petra is a senior colorist currently employed elsewhere and is happily employed. She has no prior relationship with the recruiter or Torchlight Media. She may or may not check the channel through which the message is sent.

resolution.question: A recruiter from Torchlight Media is sending Petra Kovac, a senior colorist who is happily employed elsewhere, a first-contact message about an opening. Will Petra reply at all within five business days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Petra Kovac actually sent a reply to the recruiter's message before 2026-09-11T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
